metadata.description: ITR Wala AI Agent - file Indian income tax returns from your terminal

plugins.name: itr-wala-ai-agent
plugins.description: File your Indian ITR for AY 2026-27: reads Form 16/AIS/26AS, computes both regimes with a tested Python engine, then drives the e-filing portal in a supervised browser. Handles ITR-3, s.44ADA presumptive income and Schedule FA. You always log in, pay, submit and e-verify yourself.
